descriptionTemplate:
Closing a UK company means a lot of red tape. Every time I opened the HMRC site I had more questions than answers, so I used AI as support, and I still work with a licensed insolvency practitioner.

This is Part 1 of 3: how I use AI to get through real-world red tape, using closing my own company as the example.

In this video:
• Why you need support, and why AI is only support
• Five things to do first
• What it costs, and how to use AI as leverage
• The exceptions, and why the practitioner decides
• Gmail and Drive as data sources over MCP
• Divide and conquer, and learning from every problem

thumbnailRules: Six words or fewer of text, large enough to read at 168 x 94 pixels.
All text is HTML, never AI-drawn, so it can be edited and is spelled right.
No figures, no UTR, no names, no personal data, no fake documents.
Do not promise an outcome (no 'fixed', 'solved' or 'saved').
When you have a clear photo of your face, add it on the clear side: expression matters more than polish.
